name: What documents or information should I gather before starting ADU architectural planning?
description: Before ADU architectural planning, gather property deeds, site plans, surveys, and clarify your budget, desired size, and intended use.

mainEntity.name: What documents or information should I gather before starting ADU architectural planning?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before starting ADU architectural planning, gather your property deed, existing site plans, and any relevant surveys you might have. It's also helpful to have a clear idea of your budget, desired ADU size, number of bedrooms/bathrooms, and intended use (e.g., rental, guest house). Photos of your property and examples of ADU designs you like can also guide the initial design discussions.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before ADU architectural planning, gather property deeds, site plans, surveys, and clarify your budget, desired size, and intended use.
